Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.462.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '5be30b2f056f513a66db2b9d48062a0003f1a6c62d12273da4b5d133ed966b18') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.462.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '926a3475aea969a2b37854b7e576c6393884de4fe9184ffe174aff7575c83072') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
